Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_OnlyWorldSpawn: Protect ONLY world-spawned containers. Ignore player built/placed containers.
Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_ProtectPolice_: Protect police station armories, evidence, and SWAT lockers.
Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_ProtectGunStor: Protect gun stores and their storage areas.
Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_ProtectMilitar: Protect military bases, army surplus, and tents.
Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_ProtectPrisons: Protect prison armories and cellblock lockers.
Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_PreventMoving_: Prevent picking up or moving protected containers.
Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_PreventDisasse: Prevent scrapping or dismantling protected containers.
Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_PreventSledgeh: Prevent destroying protected containers with a sledgehammer.
Sandbox_ProtectedArmories_ShowHaloWarnin: Show floating text warning above character when trying to interact with protected container.
